hints.title: Locating First Target Character
hints.text: Find the first index where character ch appears in word.

hints.title: Prefix Reversal
hints.text: If ch is found at index idx, reverse the segment from index 0 to idx inclusive, leaving the remainder unchanged.

hints.title: String Slicing or Two Pointers
hints.text: Slice word[:idx+1][::-1] + word[idx+1:] or swap characters inward using two pointers.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Linear scan to find target character followed by string reversal.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Reversing after multiple occurrences violates the specification to reverse at the FIRST occurrence only.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: In-place array swap or direct string slice runs in linear time with minimal overhead.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should locate first occurrence and reverse the substring prefix cleanly.

solutions.approach: find and slice reversal in Python 3
